settings.title: Official UK partner of Deyga & Vilvah
settings.text: We are an official UK partner of Deyga and Vilvah, two Indian natural skincare brands, so you can shop their range in the UK.

settings.title: 100% authentic
settings.text: Every product we sell is 100% authentic, from natural skincare to designer perfume.

settings.title: Fine fragrance
settings.text: Niche, Arabian and designer perfume from houses such as Tiziana Terenzi, Al Haramain, Hemel and Gucci.

settings.title: Dispatched from the UK
settings.text: Orders leave our UK base within 1–2 working days, with free UK delivery over £40.

settings.heading: Natural skincare and fine fragrance, from one UK studio
settings.text:
Swansura – The Body Studio is a UK online store for natural skincare and fine fragrance. We bring Indian natural skincare from Deyga and Vilvah to the UK, alongside niche, Arabian and designer perfume.

Everything is chosen with care, 100% authentic and delivered from the UK.
